title: Cancel a private mooring licence
summary: Learn how to cancel your private mooring licence at a Service NSW Centre, or by post or email.
intro:
If you want to cancel your private mooring licence, you can do this at a Service NSW Centre, or by post or email.

You may be required to remove the mooring apparatus from the seabed and you're responsible for any costs associated with the removal.

For more information visit Transport for NSW.
what_you_need: The PDF form: 'Private Mooring Licence Cancellation Request'

how_to_steps.text: Complete the form and submit your application in person at a service centre, or by post or email using the details on the form.

faqs.q: How can I cancel my private mooring licence?
faqs.a: You can cancel your private mooring licence at a Service NSW Centre, or by post or email.

faqs.q: Am I responsible for the costs if I cancel my licence?
faqs.a: You may be required to remove the mooring apparatus from the seabed, and you are responsible for any associated costs.
